title: Hyperscale Data, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 10, 2026 reporting the reconvened special stockholder meeting results. Stockholders approved five proposals including a reverse stock split (1-for-2 to 1-for-5 ratio), an increase in authorized Class A shares from 500 million to 2.5 billion, conversion of up to 100,000 shares of Series H Preferred for $100 million, and equity issuances to directors and executives.
key_points: The special meeting was adjourned from March 18, 2026 and reconvened on April 10, 2026 due to lack of quorum at the initial date
Proposal 1 approved: reverse stock split of Class A Common Stock by ratio of 1-for-2 to 1-for-5 at any time prior to March 17, 2027 (190.2M for, 17.4M against)
Proposal 2 approved: increase authorized Class A shares from 500,000,000 to 2,500,000,000 (173.3M for, 34.0M against)
Proposal 3 approved: conversion of up to 100,000 shares of Series H Preferred into Class A Common Stock for up to $100,000,000 (35.5M for, 16.3M against)
Proposal 4 approved: equity issuances to directors and executive officers under NYSE American Rule 711 (188.9M for, 17.6M against)
As of record date January 22, 2026, the company had 343,453,412 shares of Class A Common Stock and 24,339,228 shares of Class B Common Stock outstanding
